name: nimyaml-yamllsp
description: Lint diagnostics, JSON Schema validation, %GLOBAL/%SCHEMA directive support and embedded languages in block scalars for YAML via NimYAML's yamllsp

nimyaml.yamllsp.path.markdownDescription: Command that starts the `yamllsp` language server: a name looked up on `PATH` or an absolute path. Build it with `nim yamllsp config.nims` in the NimYAML repository.

nimyaml.yamllsp.args.description: Extra arguments passed to the language server.

nimyaml.trace.server.description: Traces the communication between VS Code and yamllsp in the output channel.

nimyaml.embedded.enabled.markdownDescription: Provide language features (diagnostics, completion, hover, go to definition, rename, …) for code in literal block scalars whose language is known: `query: | # sql`. Each such block is written to a file of its language (a *projection*) that the language's own extension serves.

nimyaml.embedded.diagnostics.enabled.markdownDescription: Show the diagnostics of embedded code on the YAML document. Diagnostics are only published for files a server analyzes, so this writes the projections of every open YAML document as it changes rather than on the first request.

nimyaml.embedded.diagnostics.debounceMs.description: Delay in milliseconds after an edit before the projections are rewritten.

enumDescriptions: In the workspace folder, so that imports and project configuration resolve.
In the system's temporary directory: nothing in the workspace, but most cross-file resolution fails.

nimyaml.embedded.projection.directory.description: The directory in the workspace folder that holds the projections when they are written to the workspace.

nimyaml.embedded.projection.manageExclud.markdownDescription: Add the projection directory to `files.exclude` and `search.exclude` in the workspace settings.

nimyaml.embedded.semanticTokens.enabled.markdownDescription: Show the semantic highlighting of embedded languages that provide it. Only token types yamllsp's legend has are kept; the others keep the colours of the grammar.

nimyaml.embedded.warnOnFoldedScalars.markdownDescription: Warn when a folded block scalar (`>`) names a language: folding joins lines, so its value is not the code shown, and it gets no language features.

nimyaml.embedded.stickyDirective.markdownDescription: Comment that sets the language of all block scalars below it: `# yaml-lsp: python`. A bare `# yaml-lsp` clears it. The comment on a block's header takes precedence.

nimyaml.embedded.compat.yamlEmbeddedLang.markdownDescription: Also accept `# yaml-embedded-languages: <language>` as the sticky directive.

nimyaml.embedded.aliases.markdownDescription: Maps names used in comments to VS Code language IDs. Names that are language IDs need no alias.

keyPattern.description: Regular expression (JavaScript) matched against the key whose value the block scalar is.

filePattern.description: Glob the YAML document's path must match.

nimyaml.embedded.keyRules.markdownDescription: Choose the language by key instead of a comment, e.g. `{"keyPattern": "^run$", "language": "shellscript", "filePattern": "**/.github/workflows/*.yml"}`. Comments take precedence.
